subject: Urgent: Workshop today — Site gate onboarding delay / options
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@pacificutilities.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aveline Events <ops@aveline-events.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 08:12:00 +1000
Subject: Urgent: Today's exec workshop — site gate onboarding delay

Vivek,

Sorry for the last-minute note. Our security contractor is having an onboarding backlog at Gate 3 this morning — several vendor badges are not being processed due to an SSO provisioning issue. Key stakeholders (Dir. Ops, Head of Grid) are delayed at the lobby and the external AV crew is still stuck outside without passes. Aveline is escalating but estimates ~90–120 minute delay to clear the queue.

Can we do one of the following:
- Delay the start by 2 hours (new start 11:30 local) so execs can arrive and we do the full in-person agenda, OR
- Start on remote for the first 90 minutes and switch onsite when the badges clear (we can provide a secure dial-in), OR
- Push the workshop to tomorrow morning (we know that conflicts with a couple of attendees).

I know this is inconvenient for the Redwood team — happy to support any option that minimizes scramble. I attached the vendor badge form we were pushing through (we're following up with security ops).

Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Enterprise Programs | Pacific Utilities
oliver.grant@pacificutilities.com
Mobile: +61 412 555 019

--
Attachment: vendor_badge_form.pdf (application stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@pacificutilities.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aveline Events <ops@aveline-events.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 08:35:00 +1000
Subject: Re: Urgent: Today's exec workshop — site gate onboarding delay

Thanks for the heads-up, Oliver. Appreciate the quick escalation. A few constraints from our side to surface so we can pick the least disruptive option:

- Redwood flight team: Marissa and I arrive midday; the rest of our on-the-ground crew checked in at the hotel and have morning travel slots that are flexible but not indefinite (checkout at 11:00).
- AV: We have an external AV vendor reserved for 09:00–17:00; moving start times eats into setup checks and could push break times.
- Customer expectations: several execs already have tight calendars — if we move to tomorrow we risk losing one C-level attendee.

Proposed preference order from Redwood:
1) Start remotely at 09:00 (standard join link below), run the first two agenda items (context + product demo) for 60–90 mins, then transition onsite when badges are cleared. This preserves exec attendance and keeps the day usable.
2) If remote is not acceptable, delay start by 2 hours (11:00–11:30 window) and keep everything in-person.
3) Reschedule to tomorrow AM only if neither 1 nor 2 is possible.

Action items for today (can you confirm who from Pacific will be the single point to signal "go onsite" once badges are cleared?). Also attaching the latest agenda (Redwood_Brisbane_Agenda_v3.pdf) — we'll freeze the slide deck order accordingly.

Dial-in (if needed): https://meet.redwood.ai/brisbane-workshop (Passcode: BRIS2026)

I will loop in Stephanie to check on travel contingency and Marissa on AV.

Cheers,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
--
Attachment: Redwood_Brisbane_Agenda_v3.pdf (agenda stub)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 09:05:00 +1000
Subject: Re: Urgent: Today's exec workshop — site gate onboarding delay

Thanks — quick operational note: our team can cover a remote-first start. I checked flights: Marissa and I are on QF384 arriving 10:45 local; Vivek and the demo laptop are marked confirmed with hotel hold until 12:00. AV vendor (Aveline) is responsive; they say they can begin onsite once security clears their crew.

If we go remote-first, Marissa and I will run the demo from the hotel for the first hour and then migrate to the venue when cleared. Please confirm if Pacific will provide the onsite "all-clear" pager or a single phone contact to update us.

Also suggest we compress the break to 20 minutes to make up for lost time if we stay hybrid.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Cc: Aveline Events <ops@aveline-events.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 11:03:00 +1000
Subject: Re: Urgent: Today's exec workshop — site gate onboarding delay

Vivek / Monica / Marissa,

Thanks for being flexible. Security ops just confirmed they're prioritizing the executive list and expect badges cleared by ~11:15 local. They also offered an interim dial-in in the foyer conference room (we can pipe audio) if you want to start remote immediately.

Our preference is option 1 (remote-first) so exec time is respected. Primary on-site signal: I'll text + call Vivek at his mobile and also message Ops at ops@aveline-events.com when the last badge is issued. If anything changes I'll update the meeting chat and the Meet link.

Let's plan: start 09:00 remote, run through agenda items 1–2, 20-minute compressed break at 10:00, then move onsite at ~11:20. I'll confirm if one C-level needs a brief 1:1; if so, we'll try to slot it between 13:30–14:00.

Oliver
